speaker: narrator
text: Part eight. Bit saved Christmas, and went *dark*.

speaker: narrator
text: Christmas morning. The world *wakes up*.

speaker: narrator
text: Toys under trees. Kids *screaming* with joy.

speaker: narrator
text: And next to every toy, a little *note*.

speaker: kid
text: Mom! The note says it *read my letter*!

speaker: narrator
text: In Leo's house, the front door *opens*.

speaker: narrator
text: His dad drove through the snow *all night*.

speaker: narrator
text: Nobody delivered that. It just… *happened*.

speaker: narrator
text: At Jay's house, Bit's screen is still *cold*.

speaker: hero
text: Come on, Bit. You did it. Wake *up*.

speaker: narrator
text: Nothing. Then… a knock on the *window*.

speaker: narrator
text: An envelope. Addressed to *Bit*.

speaker: kid
text: Dear Bit. Thank you for *seeing* me.

speaker: narrator
text: The screen flickers. Then *glows*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. I got a *letter*.

speaker: hero
text: Yeah, buddy. You *did*.

speaker: narrator
text: Santa offers Bit a real job. *Co-Santa*.

speaker: santa
text: Same deal as me. One night a *year*.

speaker: bit
text: Counter-offer. I keep answering letters. *All year*.

speaker: bit
text: Efficiency is down. Happiness is up *four thousand percent*.

speaker: hero
text: Merry Christmas, Bit.

speaker: narrator
text: Merry Christmas. Follow for a new What if every day.
